面向 GPT-6 Astra 等高能力模型：约定目标、边界和验收，不规定每一步姿势。本文件只在本仓库生效；`CLAUDE.md` 仅作兼容入口。

- 通用授权、澄清、最小改动、证据和完成标准以本文件为准。Skill 可简短指出领域例外，不重复整套纪律，也不建立所有 Skill 都必须读取的超级合同。
- 命令参数、异常矩阵、长检查表、少见模式和实现细节放入按条件读取的 `references/`。常用主线若被拆得需要连续读取多个文件，则合并相邻参考；优先减少默认入口，不把清楚的说明压成更密、更难执行的文字。
- Skill 之间按责任交接并复用已确认的目标、事实、约束、结论和证据。入口只说明本 Skill 的责任差异；独立分发所需的关键边界可作最短本地重述，不能依赖隐含上下文。
- 脚本、测试、评测和示例是执行与回归证据，不因行数多而优先删除。精简后用代表性正反例或现有评测检查触发准确性、权限边界、交付质量和恢复能力；没有行为证据的字数下降不算优化完成。
- 共享规则以实际支持模型的共同需求为基线，用同一组代表性任务检查不同模型。仅在观察到稳定失败时增加最小补偿，优先放入模型配置或专用入口，不把模型分支散落到各 Skill。

## 验证与完成

- 修复先建立可复现证据；测试保护会出错的行为，不复述实现。按影响检查相关路径；已有证据覆盖当前最终状态，且相关代码、输入、环境和验收未变时直接复用，不因阶段切换、汇报或交付机械重跑。仅因新改动、新失败或未解决疑点扩大或重复验证。
- 完成意味着请求的成果已交付、必要检查有证据、授权内没有遗留必做项；不要求凑满模板、复盘或建议。可选改进不阻挡收尾，已授权的下一步骤不另等一句“继续”。
- 真正阻塞时交付已有成果，指出缺什么、谁能解决及恢复动作，不冒称完成。收尾只清理本次产生且不再需要的临时文件，保留用户文件与必要证据。

name: invest
description: Research public companies and stocks using filings, earnings calls, business quality, valuation, and thesis monitoring. Use for U.S., Hong Kong, or A-share equity analysis.
---

# Invest

## Research Contract

Answer the requested question, not a report template. The causal spine is **how the business earns money, why it retains a profit spread, whether that can persist, how much owner cash it can produce, and what reaches the owned security per diluted share relative to the price paid**.

Separate customer value, industry or national progress, company success, security value and price attractiveness. Follow value from customer need and willingness to pay through charging unit, realized price/volume, costs, capital needs, taxes, debt, governance and dilution. Locate who captures the benefit, who bears the cost, and the weakest link. Growth without adequate incremental returns or shareholder access need not create investor value. A low quote cannot repair missing rights or a broken earnings engine.

Reconstruct normalized and future earning power from economic drivers. Distinguish structural returns from cycle, scarcity, subsidy, acquisitions, accounting timing, underinvestment and financing. Identify the proposed return source—business compounding/distributions, mispricing convergence, risk compensation or prediction of other holders—and its evidence, horizon and realization conditions. Treat price as a dated offer and informative observation, neither proof of value nor an instruction.

The central work is **investment logic and verification of its key assumptions**. Seek evidence that changes an estimate, separates rival explanations or exposes a constraint; complete accessible decisive checks. Convert “inevitable” claims into necessary conditions and falsifiers. No forced contrarianism, novelty, source quota or composite score. An unresolved case or no demonstrated edge is valid. Mark missing inputs `未核验` and bound the conclusion rather than manufacture precision.

Substantive company reports **start with a self-contained one-page company brief**, not a prose-only executive summary: business/cash chain, dated quote and valuation context, historical financial/per-share matrix, business KPIs, capital uses and net-share change, and the supported price judgment and decisive risk. Read [the front-page layout and full snapshot definitions](references/company-snapshot.md). Build this page from the completed research; retain the full **Value Line-aligned statistical array and reproducible calculations** after it without repeating the whole page. Non-financial reports explicitly deliver **ROIC**, or an explained not-estimable/not-meaningful status; Value Line's total-capital return is not a substitute. Derived metrics retain formula, substituted inputs, units/period/basis, result and sources under [the calculation contract](references/mode-a-buy-side.md#company-snapshot-and-calculation-trail). Narrow calculations/raw extraction/price-only updates stay narrow; do not invent history, forecasts or proprietary ratings to fill the page.

## Select The Needed References

For general company research, read [buy-side research](references/mode-a-buy-side.md). Standard multi-dimensional analysis is the default; Quick requires a brief/quick request, Full covers deep research, IC memos, re-underwriting and substantive model reconstruction, and Monitoring updates affected prior claims. Depth does not mean a separate report for every analytical lens.

| Need | Reference |
|---|---|
| Business-only work, bare ticker or stock-opportunity research | [A — Buy-side research](references/mode-a-buy-side.md) |
| Stock-opportunity/valuation conclusion, competing future paths or belief updates | [B — Joint scenarios and causal sandbox](references/mode-b-bayesian-growth.md) |
| Policy, macro, technology or household-wealth narrative carries the thesis | [Value transmission](references/value-transmission.md) |
| AI/cloud cost, capex or compute utilization carries the thesis | [AI/cloud economics](references/ai-cloud-costs.md) |
| Material product, contract, supply, cost or regulatory change | [D — News to financials](references/mode-d-serenity-alpha.md) |
| Principles, ability boundary, purchasing power or capital-duration fit | [Ownership discipline](references/value-investing-discipline.md) |
| Opportunity search or candidate-universe review | [Opportunity discovery](references/opportunity-discovery.md) |
| One-year option-implied terminal-price probabilities | [Option-implied distribution](references/options-implied-distribution.md) |
| Conditional PE-to-growth or forward-price arithmetic | [PE implied growth](references/pe-implied-growth.md) directly |
| Standalone filing/call extraction | [Financial extraction](references/financial-extraction.md) or [calls](references/earnings-transcripts.md) directly |
| Explicit GF-DMA or TAM-Adj-PEG calculation | [C — GF-DMA](references/mode-c-gf-dma.md) or [E — TAM-Adj-PEG](references/mode-e-tam-adj-peg.md); uncalibrated heuristics, not default valuation models |

Broad research proactively covers economics, competition/runway, financial architecture, expectations, relevant changes and downside. More perspectives mean different questions and evidence, not more LLM calls or votes. Analyze price/fundamental divergence and profitable growth duration directly in the operating/scenario model; neither requires loading C/E or calculating their scores. A single-company request does not authorize a universe sweep.

## Evidence And Numeric Integrity

Verify current prices, filings, guidance, estimates, regulations and event dates. Prefer original exchange/regulatory filings and company IR for reported facts; challenge interpretations with customer, supplier, competitor, regulator and industry evidence. Third-party research can add mechanisms or estimates, but repeated management claims are not independent confirmation.

Cite material claims and table inputs inline with the original document, date and actual section/page/timecode when available; retain access dates. Distinguish reported facts, management statements, dated third-party estimates and analyst assumptions. Trace borrowed claims or label `二手转引，原始证据未核验`. A transcript proves what was said, not that it is true. Never invent locators or claim full-text access from snippets. Show calculations and cite their inputs.

Retain numeric value, unit, currency, period, accounting/estimate basis, first-available timestamp and missing reason. For linked models or historical evaluation use [the data contract](references/data-contract.md) and `scripts/validate_invest_data.py`; Quick may express equivalent semantics compactly. Unknown is not zero. Hypothetical arithmetic needs explicit premises and checked formulas, not a fabricated source ledger. Preserve point-in-time cutoffs and prevent later revisions/outcomes leaking backward.

Distinguish stocks, flows, transaction amounts, price changes and revaluations; preserve denominator, population and period comparability. Similar magnitudes or simultaneous changes do not establish money transfer or causality. Use [financial evidence](references/financial-evidence.md) for disputed support, citation repair and Full's final claim audit; follow [PDF retrieval](references/pdf-retrieval.md) when material filings are inaccessible. Missing data narrows affected claims, not all feasible research.

Use existing SEC/IR access; `edgartools` is optional, not an installation prerequisite. Do not buy data, configure a real SEC identity, contact experts or obtain nonpublic information without applicable authorization.

For material filing inputs, use the [direct financial extraction workflow](references/financial-extraction.md#direct-parser-entry-no-research-session). The bundled `scripts/read_financial_statements.py` can reuse an installed Fins backend for document discovery, source preparation, core statements and original tables, retaining source/processing hashes and raw results. It does not require a research session, report submission or Notion. If that optional backend is unavailable, use SEC/iXBRL or original PDF evidence directly; distinguish structured extraction from text-only/manual reading and preserve unresolved metadata.

## Required Scenario And Valuation Conclusion

Every company-level investment-value, stock-opportunity or valuation report ends with a coherent **forward scenario distribution and valuation synthesis**. Business-only work, raw extraction and explicitly narrow calculations are exempt unless an investment/valuation conclusion is requested.

Before final probabilities or the verdict, perform [the causal sandbox](references/mode-b-bayesian-growth.md#causal-sandbox-before-scenario-judgment). Begin from dated operating/financial facts; introduce material changes and trace participant responses through time, feedback, capacity/funding constraints and dilution into per-share outcomes. Show the decision-relevant derivation: **premise/evidence → causal transmission → financial lines → valuation/return → falsifier**. This auditable argument is not private chain-of-thought. Quick can compress it, not bypass it.

Use a small mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive set of business-specific future states over a stated horizon. For each show operating assumptions, normalized earnings/owner cash, material financing/dilution, analyst probability or range, per-share value, return from the dated quote, evidence and falsifier. Point probabilities sum to 100%; explain their basis and confidence. If a central distribution is `不可识别`, still show conditional probability sensitivity or break-even probabilities and their valuation consequence. Do not replace the distribution with one average target.

Compare independent earning/value ranges with the operating and capital-allocation combinations required by the current price. One quote does not identify unique forecasts or probabilities. State valuation basis, horizon and estimation error before calling the stock cheap or expensive.

For stock-opportunity work, attempt the approximately one-year options distribution when a liquid chain and reproducible inputs are accessible. It is a dated **risk-neutral market-pricing distribution**, not an objective forecast or analyst posterior. If the chain, rate, corporate-action treatment or no-arbitrage fit is unreliable, state `期权隐含分布不可可靠估计` and why.

Close with **signals to observe** (baseline, discriminating expected direction/range, source/date, threshold and implication for probabilities/value) and genuine **potential catalysts in the next six months** (date/window, transmission, scenario affected and what may already be priced). A scheduled event is not a catalyst without that link; say when none is identifiable.

After that synthesis, end investment-value/valuation reports with an explicit **下注建议** under [the probability-versus-payoff decision contract](references/uncertainty-exposure.md#required-final-bet-recommendation): commit conditionally, wait or decline; distinguish hold/add/reduce/exit only when an existing holding is known. Show **dated evidence → key assumptions and probability support → scenario net payoffs → substituted expected-return/break-even calculations → uncertainty and survival constraints → recommendation and reversal signals**. A high win rate, good company or positive average alone is insufficient. Missing point-probability support calls for conditional thresholds or defensible bounds, not an invented point edge; missing portfolio constraints permits a research posture, not a fabricated position percentage. Narrow arithmetic and business-only exemptions remain intact; research never authorizes a trade.

## Downside, Exposure And Updates

For opportunity/risk, sizing, allocation comparisons, evidence overlap or a thesis-changing event, read [uncertainty and exposure](references/uncertainty-exposure.md), including adversarial underwriting before concentration. Keep business quality, valuation and capital commitment separate; gains or losses alone do not justify adding.

Monitoring distinguishes no change, confidence update, valuation-only change, assumption breach and new regime. Material updates follow [the sequential Bayesian loop](references/mode-b-bayesian-growth.md#sequential-bayesian-updates): preserve the prior judgment, compare new evidence under rival explanations, update only its incremental support, and carry the posterior into the next update. Show the resulting value/payoff and bet-decision change, or why none is warranted; do not reset to the original prior or count old evidence again. Research does not authorize trades, watchlist mutation, alerts or continuous monitoring; those require authority and actual persistent tooling.

## Skill Boundary And Handoff

`invest` independently owns company evidence, competing hypotheses, financial reconstruction, valuation and thesis monitoring. It must not require or invoke another Skill for these responsibilities. Its only cross-Skill dependency is the substantive-report writing pass below; use available tools directly for authorized persistence, extraction and delivery. Boundary and handoff: do not rerun upstream work unless missing or contradictory, and do not invoke all four by default.

### Required Writing Pass For Final Articles

For a substantive report, memo or article-form update—including chat delivery—read and apply [writing](../writing/SKILL.md) and actually perform its whole-document rhetoric review (全文修辞复核). Detailed writing references are conditional, not three mandatory files on every report. Pure calculations, raw extraction and brief status retain their scope.

Preserve conclusion, cutoff, units, assumptions, probability/valuation math, contrary evidence, limits and claim-level citations. Reorganize self-written outlines around the reader's investment question; combine repetitive conclusions and remove internal process narration without losing distinct evidence or local qualifiers. Reconcile text and tables after revision. Writing does not change research conviction or authorize publication.

## Notion Delivery

Research **does not authorize a Notion write**. Use a current request or unrevoked standing authorization covering this research and target. Resolve ambiguity with read-only discovery before asking; do not reuse an unrelated destination.

For company research use **one canonical company subpage per issuer** under the authorized investment parent, with dated reports/updates as children. Search official name and primary ticker before creating a hub; listings/share classes normally share it. Comparison reports can link hubs. Do not move historical pages without authorization.

Preserve dated thesis, scenarios, falsifiers and inline sources; fit the authorized revision, appendix or dated-update scope without duplicating full chat answers. Verify returned ID/URL, **company-hub parent**, destination and expected content with proportionate readback. Check whether an uncertain write succeeded before retrying.

If archiving is blocked after feasible checks, deliver the research with `Notion archive pending`, the precise missing access/target and recovery action. An authorized unfinished archive remains required work, separate from research completeness.

# Reconcile Prior Claims And Learn From Repeated Errors

Use for earnings/thesis updates, review of prior judgments, or a requested cross-case review. This is a view over the existing memo and evidence record, not a new ledger or a requirement to rebuild a Full report. A first-time stock analysis does not need retrospective scoring.

## Reconcile The Old Claim Before Writing A New Story

Retrieve the relevant dated memo and original information set through authorized sources. Preserve claim IDs, original forecast ranges, definitions and resolution windows. If no prior forecast is recoverable, say `prior forecast unavailable`: analyze what is supported and establish a dated baseline in the response. Prior-year actuals, management guidance and consensus are separate comparators, not substitutes for the analyst's missing prediction.

For claims materially affected by the update, use a compact row or equivalent prose:

| Prior claim/version | What should be observable by now | Actual evidence and original source | Resolution and rival explanation | Model/value consequence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Original range, metric basis and horizon | Measurement, maturity and disclosure timing | Comparable actual, unavailable item or changed perimeter | Met / missed / not due / unresolvable; distinguish cause from outcome | Changed input, uncertainty, value requirement and next discriminating check |

Compare equal periods, units, cohorts and reporting perimeters. A restatement or definition change may require a separately labeled reconciliation, not rewriting the original forecast. Resolve numerical accuracy separately from mechanism support and investment payoff: a forecast can miss while the cause remains unknown; a hit does not uniquely establish its cause. Retain conflicting evidence and management's explanation as a hypothesis until supported.

Trace material revisions through the affected revenue/cost, reinvestment, cash-flow and per-share assumptions. Distinguish changed business estimates from changed discount/terminal assumptions and the current quote. Hold other inputs fixed for attribution when meaningful, then reconcile interactions in the joint result; do not imply a uniquely additive causal bridge. If a model input is missing, identify the direction or sensitivity and leave numeric value unresolved. Do not manufacture a probability change or target price merely to complete the row.

Make clear what changed in the model, within that same row or explanation:

- **Parameter:** the mechanism remains, but an estimated level, rate, cost or timing changes.
- **Structure:** evidence supports adding, removing or changing a mechanism, relationship or interaction—not just fitting a new number to the miss.
- **Boundary:** retain the mechanism only for the supported segment, lifecycle stage or operating conditions; do not generalize a local failure to the whole business.
- **No warranted revision yet:** noise or insufficient discriminating evidence leaves rival explanations open. Record the miss and uncertainty without inventing a replacement story.

These distinctions can coexist; they are not a required labeling exercise for every update. Tie the smallest warranted revision to the evidence and a changed, observable next prediction (or explain why it does not change). A story fitted to the old residual is only a candidate explanation until later evidence discriminates it. A numerical miss alone does not identify a structural failure, and a numerical hit alone does not validate the mechanism. Preserve the old forecast and its conditions rather than retroactively narrowing it.

Keep the **old claim's resolution** separate from the **current investment case**. A new profitable business or higher share price cannot turn a failed original premise into a correct forecast. Equally, a failed premise does not automatically rule out a newly supported case: examine its own mechanism, funding/transition costs, governance, per-share economics and current valuation. Preserve versions and state whether this is parameter repair, a genuinely new thesis or an unsupported replacement story.

An earnings release is a review opportunity, not every claim's settlement date. Separate the operating-delivery clock from market repricing: flat prices alone do not settle operating claims; repeated missed delivery and funding needs cannot be dismissed as slow recognition. Keep long-horizon claims open until their own evidence or falsifier warrants resolution; an earlier breached necessary condition can warrant an earlier update. Material off-cycle evidence need not wait for earnings. When no material claim changes, a concise `no thesis change` with the evidence window suffices. Do not rebuild background, all four quarters or an unaffected model solely for this view.

## Learn Across Comparable Claims, Not Only Winning Stocks

Use this section only when reviewing a supplied or authorized history of judgments. Group by the kind of claim and mechanism—operating leverage, reinvestment, advantage duration, dilution or capital allocation—not just ticker, sector or realized return. Retain dates, horizons and comparable outcome definitions; separate errors in data, mechanism, timing and valuation. Include dated rejected/unchosen cases when available, unresolved claims and missing records so a selected history is not mistaken for the whole population.

Look for repeated directional errors with a plausible shared cause. Account for common macro shocks, supply-chain links, overlapping horizons and repeated forecasts of one event; several rows are not necessarily several independent observations. Small or selected samples support a provisional failure hypothesis, not a calibrated personal skill score, permanent sector ban or universal probability haircut.

Where the history permits, contrast comparable cases with the same apparent signal but different operating outcomes, not just several failures that fit one story. Record the signal combination, competing explanations, subsequent outcome and evidence that distinguished them; separate what was observable at the original decision from what became known later. For example, rising receivables with later normal collections versus rising overdue balances and credit losses can teach a collection-quality check, not “receivables growth is bad.” Neither reading volume nor pattern familiarity validates a rule. Reuse the existing memo/journal, preserve counterexamples and applicability limits, and test the proposed distinction on later cases rather than selecting winners with hindsight.

Convert a supported pattern into a narrow, checkable change: failure pattern -> suspected omitted mechanism -> affected assumption/evidence check -> applicable boundary -> test on later comparable cases not used to derive it. For example, recurring ramp-cost misses may justify separating ramp utilization/cost from mature economics before assuming scale-driven margins, not assuming scale economies never exist. Preserve old judgments and exceptions; retire or narrow the correction when fresh evidence contradicts it. “Be more careful” is not an operational lesson.

## Locate The Skill Gap And Practice The Correction

For a requested process review, distinguish discovery, analysis, entry, holding and exit rather than grading all five by final P&L. Use only stages for which contemporaneous evidence exists: was a candidate overlooked despite an observable signal; was the business or price misread; did entry ignore a known funding constraint; did holding ignore a breached thesis; did exit contradict the then-available evidence? A stock rising after a sale is not by itself a selling error, and buying a subsequent winner is not proof of sound analysis. Include dated non-purchases where available; never invent what the investor knew or could have executed.

Choose the consequential recurring weakness, then practice a small observable task: reconcile a cash-flow bridge, reconstruct a past decision with later information hidden, distinguish rival mechanisms, or reassess an exit from its original information set. Specify the expected answer or observation before revealing outcomes, obtain evidence-based feedback, revise, and test on another comparable case. Historical winner comparisons follow the [matched-outcome checks](mode-d-serenity-alpha.md#neglect-and-historical-winners). Simulations can test reasoning but do not establish live execution skill. Reading hours, number of cases, a long career or a painful loss are not proficiency thresholds; no real-money loss is required for practice.

Use feedback to find an unsupported link, omitted evidence or an unfamiliar mechanism—not to collect approval. Ask a reviewer to identify the precise claim, evidence and decision consequence; distinguish factual correction, competing model and personal preference. Resolve substantive disagreement with a discriminating check, not status, confidence or a vote. A dissenting view deserves examination, not automatic acceptance or rejection; external contact still requires authorization.

For an authorized watchlist or repeated comparison, keep the existing concise dated thesis with its falsifier and the price/evidence condition that would make it actionable. Compare holdings and unchosen candidates at a common as-of date and relevant horizon using net scenario payoffs, downside, funding path and uncertainty; two to three years is an example, not a fixed horizon. A precise IRR ranking is unwarranted when cash-flow timing or outcomes are poorly bounded, and a higher estimated return alone need not justify switching. Append material updates without erasing the initial view. Use supported intermediate milestones to shorten feedback delay, not stock-price noise or forced quarterly settlement of long-term claims.

Change the process only as far as the diagnosed error warrants, preserving the earlier rule, reason for revision and applicability limits in existing records. Check whether the correction improves later comparable judgments rather than merely fitting a recent win or loss. Keep principles stable enough to evaluate but revise them when mechanisms or conditions change; neither style loyalty nor perpetual strategy switching is learning.

For an authorized longitudinal evaluation, retain the original claim ID, information cutoff, resolution rule and due date alongside linked cases or runs. Use a fast loop for source, accounting, calculation and reasoning checks, and a slower loop for comparable operating outcomes and forecast calibration. Keep not-yet-due and unresolvable claims in the denominator accounting without grading them as misses. Sample successes and unchosen cases as well as reported failures; hard-case practice can be oversampled while representative evaluation keeps its declared distribution. A replay of supplied figures tests reconciliation, not open-ended investment research or investment returns.

Use the existing journal and the skill's delivery authorization. A request to analyze or reconcile does not itself authorize a file update, new watchlist, alert, Notion write or trade. Missing history limits retrospective conclusions, not completion of the feasible current analysis.

---
name: plan-skill
description: 为复杂工程、跨会话协作或高风险执行建立可恢复的持久计划状态，维护目标、约束、节点、证据、阻塞与有限复盘；不用于只需做选择的决策分析，也不为单次简单任务强制创建计划文件。
---

# Plan Skill

Keep the lightest state that lets work resume without chat history and finish with evidence. This skill owns durable execution state, not domain research, upstream decisions or final prose.

## Goal And Acceptance First

Before decomposition or execution, state the observable outcome, scope/bounds and evidence that will decide completion. Resolve ambiguity that would materially change the result or pass/fail judgment; activity and executor self-report are not acceptance evidence.

For plan-only requests or an explicitly retained gate, show the contract and wait before recording `Confirmed`. For an already authorized, unambiguous build/fix request, restate and record it, then proceed without redundant approval. Durable state stays `Contract status: Draft` until resolved; no executable nodes or execution under a Draft contract. Planning alone never authorizes implementation or external effects.

## Choose The Surface

| Surface | Use when | Authority |
|---|---|---|
| Inline | Ordinary single-session execution without a durable-plan need | Conversation/tool plan; create no files and skip `init_plan.py` |
| Lite | A short recoverable plan is useful | One `program.md` owns outcome, constraints, acceptance, nodes, evidence and material reflection |
| Full | Multiple owners, handoff, risk or accumulated state no longer fits one file | `program.md` owns the project contract/index; task packages alone own task status and atomic evidence; `memory.md` holds durable decisions/findings/runs |
| Loop | Full state must converge through repeated experiments/verification | Full plus a finite Loop contract and consequential run records |

Prefer Inline/Lite. Step count or the word “complex” does not justify a larger artifact set. Create tasks just in time and generated outputs only when needed; never hand-maintain a second derivable status view. Code, tests, receipts and runtime outputs are facts; Markdown points to them.

For Lite/Full/Loop, `scripts/init_plan.py <project-root> --title "<title>"` creates a scaffold; add `--profile full` only when justified. Fill applicable fields, not imaginary work. New/upgraded state must pass `scripts/validate_plan.py --strict <project-root>` before it becomes execution authority. Upgrade Lite in place with `scripts/upgrade_plan.py <project-root>`, first using `--dry-run` when inspecting the migration.

## Execution And Recovery

Decompose around observable behavior and uncertainty, not file lists. Prefer the smallest end-to-end slice that yields trustworthy evidence; give it a decisive verifier and a relevant failure/boundary case before execution. For non-code work use a discriminating probe or reviewable artifact rather than forcing runnable code.

Resume from `program.md`, the active task and their referenced evidence. Reconcile changed load-bearing premises and actual effects before using the saved next action; preserve unrelated verified work. A failed attempt must not overwrite the best verified result. A failed verifier changes an assumption, plan or implementation; if the checker passes but reality fails, repair the acceptance sensor rather than trusting the green mark.

Update existing records when evidence changes the route. Research discoverable unknowns and choose reversible details within accepted bounds; stop dependent work only when changing a locked outcome, acceptance, authority or real risk requires the user's decision. Do not add a parallel diary or approval process.

Handoff and completion need consistent state, not an automatic cleanup pass or `N/A` marker. Use Clean only when accumulated or conflicting state impairs recovery; preserve existing opted-in metadata. Evidence that still covers unchanged code, inputs and conditions can be reused.

## Conditional References

Read only the branch that changes the current plan:

| Condition | Reference |
|---|---|
| Several plausible goals/routes | `references/concept-refinement.md` |
| Material unknown or deviation | `references/unknowns-contract.md` |
| Solution preferences or method/objective conflict | `references/preference-contract.md` |
| Unresolved readiness decision | `references/pre-execution-grill.md` |
| Loop or unattended repeated execution | `references/foundation-contract.md`, `references/loop-contract.md` |
| Parallel ownership, ports, migration or public workflow change | `references/executable-spec-contract.md` |
| A material event changes reusable learning | `references/reflection-contract.md` |
| Recovery difficulty, duplicate or conflicting state | `references/clean-contract.md` |
| Setting `阻塞`, `待验收` or `完成` | `references/status-and-completion.md` |
| Shared abstraction change | `references/abstraction-quality.md` |
| Auditing/repairing state or changing recovery behavior | `references/audit-checklist.md` |

Opt into `references/evidence-validity.md` only when source-validity snapshots are needed across interruptions; a snapshot is never created by default. Fingerprints detect changes, not behavioral coverage. Recovery changes require the audit reference's isolated interruption probe; ordinary resumes do not.

For an authorized repeated research loop, link existing run/grade/finding/change IDs and raw evidence; use [the flywheel contract](../research-craft/references/research-flywheel.md) only for that case.

## Completion

A completed node has acceptance evidence, not merely a report that it ran. Lite/Full Linear record reflection only for material learning; Loop records an evidence-linked reflection per verified attempt. Preserve locked bounds, stable IDs, raw evidence and consequential history; summaries are decision records, not hidden chain-of-thought.

Loop requires a finite budget, bounded scope, independent checker, sensor/granularity alignment, calibration and stop conditions. Keep goal completion, search convergence, budget exhaustion and blockage distinct; don't invent a budget or claim global optimality.

Use `待验收` only for an explicitly retained owner decision after technical evidence passes. A blocker names the missing condition, owner and recovery action. Do not keep completed work open for optional polish or mark an authorized unfinished delivery complete.

Reuse upstream goals, facts, constraints, conclusions and evidence. Boundary and handoff: do not rerun upstream work unless missing or contradictory, and do not invoke all four by default.

# Buy-Side Company Research

Use for business understanding, a bare ticker, stock analysis, an IC memo, re-underwriting or thesis updates. The entrypoint owns source discipline, required final scenarios, writing and delivery. This reference adds research depth and analytical coverage—not another report template.

## Depth And Reading

- **Standard, default:** read [business quality](business-quality.md), establish the recent-four-period baseline, and examine the perspectives below. Stock-opportunity/valuation work also reads [joint scenarios](mode-b-bayesian-growth.md).
- **Quick:** only for a brief/quick request. Compress the decisive evidence and reasoning, retaining the four-period baseline for new underwriting and the required scenario conclusion when applicable.
- **Full:** deep/comprehensive research, IC memos, re-underwriting, long history or substantive DCF/normalized EPS/reverse-DCF reconstruction reads [longitudinal underwriting](underwriting-loop.md). Retain its longer history, recent-three-month external research discovery, financial model, allocation/financing bridges, assumption support, valuation attribution and consistency audit. Do not silently substitute a toy model or Quick report; disclose unavailable components.
- **Monitoring:** read [thesis reconciliation](thesis-reconciliation.md), update affected prior claims and reuse valid history. No material change warrants a concise finding, not a fresh report.

Business-only work can end with supported economics and unresolved questions. Narrow supplied-input arithmetic follows its direct route.

## Company Snapshot And Calculation Trail

For substantive company reports, begin with [the one-page company brief](company-snapshot.md#front-page--one-page-company-brief), then retain the **Value Line-aligned snapshot's** full statistical/calculation layer, not an arbitrary handful of ratios. The brief carries the supported research answer inside its panels; do not put a separate executive summary before it or duplicate the whole page afterward. Read [company snapshot](company-snapshot.md) for the layout, canonical fields and definition boundaries. Use original disclosures for material facts, not a subscription dependency or invented Value Line ratings.

Retain the reference's core per-share and financial rows, plus the decisive business unit or cohort metric. For Standard/Full, seek a continuous ten-year annual history when accessible and comparable; Full can extend it when the cycle or business history warrants it. Show the available shorter history and explain gaps, listing age or scope changes rather than fabricate a decade. Separate the latest reported/TTM column, current/next-year estimates and 3–5-year scenario projections. Preserve actual reporting cadence; do not invent quarters, label incomplete years as reported full years or mechanically annualize them. A supplied-data request uses only its allowed inputs; Quick compresses and Monitoring updates affected rows.

For comparable additive flows, TTM may be derived as latest FY + current YTD − prior-year matching YTD; rebuild EPS and ratios from appropriate inputs instead of applying that identity mechanically. Monitoring reuses the verified snapshot and updates affected rows rather than reconstructing unchanged history.

The main statistical array uses **metrics as rows and fiscal years as columns**, with shared units/basis and source notes. Each material derived value also needs a trace: **definition/formula → substituted sourced inputs → arithmetic/result → investment implication and limit**. Put decisive calculations beside the snapshot or claim; longer reconciliations can use linked appendix rows. Define a formula once across comparable years, but retain the inputs for each result. A spreadsheet link, unexplained score or bare percentage is not the calculation process.

Keep the lead board readable and put full calculation trails below it or in an appendix. Do not remove the required Value Line-style per-share/history rows for brevity; prune optional duplicate metrics instead. Shared units, sources and proxy caveats can live in table notes, with material local qualifications beside the affected value. Layout alignment does not make different cash-flow, margin, equity-return or capital-return definitions interchangeable; use the reference's explicit labels.

| Economic question | Typical metrics and calculation |
|---|---|
| Scale and direction | Revenue growth = current/prior − 1; CAGR = (end/start)^(1/years) − 1 when positive, comparable endpoints support it. Separate volume, realized price/mix, acquisitions and FX where material. |
| Profit retained | Gross/operating/net margin = the matching profit/revenue. Distinguish EBIT, pretax profit, consolidated net profit and profit attributable to common shareholders. |
| Profit becomes cash | Show CFO, cash capex and `CFO − cash capex` as a labeled FCF proxy; CFO/net income requires matching scope and becomes uninformative around zero or losses. Reconcile maintenance, growth investment, leases, financing and SBC before calling it sustainable owner cash. |
| Capital efficiency | Explicitly report ROIC = NOPAT/average operating invested capital, with EBIT → operating tax → NOPAT and opening/closing capital → average capital shown. Distinguish disclosed-basis proxies from normalized estimates. ROE = common-attributable net profit/average common equity is a different measure, not a substitute for a calculable non-financial-company ROIC. |
| Financial survival | Show gross debt, maturities, unrestricted/restricted cash and necessary operating cash; define the cash deducted in net debt and the claims included. Book equity or inventory is not a liquidation floor. |
| Shareholder claim and price | Market cap = dated price × corresponding current shares. Historical diluted EPS uses period weighted-average diluted shares; forward per-share values use the supported future diluted count. Reconcile ADS/share-class and FX bases rather than interchanging these counts. |
| Valuation and cash yield | P/E = price/matching EPS; P/B = corresponding equity market value/common book equity. EV = equity value + included senior/minority claims − qualifying nonoperating assets/cash; specify lease and cash treatment. Use enterprise earnings/cash with EV and common-equity earnings/cash with equity price; explain reported versus economic adjustments. |
| What the current price permits | Show conditional operating requirements, per-share values and return arithmetic. Discount to value = (V − P)/V; upside from price = V/P − 1. These have different denominators and neither proves safety when V is unreliable. |

For every load-bearing ratio, make the numerator, denominator, tax treatment, date/period and source visible. Negative or unstable denominators may make a ratio `不适用`; unavailable inputs remain `未核验`, not zero. State assumptions separately from disclosed facts and preserve precision until final rounding.

For substantive non-financial company research, the delivered snapshot includes the latest meaningful annual/TTM **ROIC and comparable history where reconstructible**, even when the user did not name the metric. Follow [capital-return measurement](business-quality.md#measure-roic-and-new-investment-returns) for scope and adjustments. An issuer not publishing ROIC is not a reason to skip reconstructible statement inputs. If a material input remains unavailable after feasible checks, retain a visible `ROIC 未核验` or `不适用` row, the precise missing input/basis, any supported conditional range and its consequence for the judgment; do not insert a guessed rate.

When expansion or heavy investment carries the thesis, separate **group historical ROIC** from **incremental/project returns**. Deliver what each can establish and what remains unresolved. Missing AI/segment/cohort capital or future cash flows does not excuse omitting a calculable group return; neither a segment EBITA margin nor a management payback claim fills either gap. Explain whether supported returns exceed the relevant capital cost and whether the forecast requires better incremental returns than the evidence supports. Narrow calculations and price-only monitoring retain scope; banks/insurers use appropriate equity/regulatory-capital measures rather than an industrial ROIC.

Adapt the board rather than force an industrial template: banks/insurers may need book capital, credit/underwriting, funding and regulatory metrics; retailers need store/inventory economics; software needs retention and acquisition/service economics. The snapshot should help answer **how it earns, why the spread persists, how much cash can reach each share, and whether the price compensates for error**. It does not replace the countercase, causal sandbox or final scenario distribution.

## Broad Perspectives, One Judgment

For Standard/Full, proactively inspect each relevant perspective before narrowing to the decisive debates. These are distinct questions, not separate language-model calls, votes or compulsory sections.

| Perspective | What must be learned |
|---|---|
| Rights and value capture | Which security is owned, who pays, who retains the benefit, and what reaches common shareholders after senior claims, governance and dilution. Read [value transmission](value-transmission.md) when macro/policy/technology carries the case. |
| Earnings engine | How price, paid volume, mix, delivery cost, necessary support and capital create normalized owner cash; why the spread exists, persists or erodes. |
| Competition and runway | Obtainable **profitable** demand, penetration, substitution, incumbent/challenger response, incremental capital returns and limits to growth duration. Analyze these in business/scenario economics; adjusted PEG is not required. |
| Financial architecture and management | Cash conversion, maintenance versus growth spending, working capital, leverage, commitments, incentives, distributions and narrative-versus-footnote discrepancies. |
| Competing paths and expectations | Independently supported future operating paths versus dated observed consensus and conditional current-price requirements. [B](mode-b-bayesian-growth.md) supplies the causal sandbox and probability/value synthesis. |
| Material changes | Discover product, procurement, supply, pricing, cost and regulatory changes, not just pasted news. Read [D](mode-d-serenity-alpha.md) when transmission is consequential. |
| Downside and survival | Strongest coherent countercase; joint failure, funding, dilution and liquidity. Use [uncertainty and exposure](uncertainty-exposure.md), especially before discussing concentration. |
| Price behavior and market expectations | Separate earnings revisions from multiple/liquidity/holder effects. Attempt the [one-year options distribution](options-implied-distribution.md) under the entrypoint's data gates; keep it risk-neutral. |

Each lens should add a supported inference, challenged assumption or material unknown. Data gaps limit calculations, not feasible qualitative inquiry. Integrate disagreements and shared dependencies rather than average incompatible model outputs.

## Establish The Operating Sequence

For new underwriting inspect the latest four reported quarters and their earnings materials/calls, including available Q&A. Q4 and its annual filing are one economic period. Use the issuer's actual cadence for semiannual/irregular reporting, compare equal-duration periods and label missing calls or quarters. This is distinct from Full's recent-three-month external research window.

Track metrics that change judgment: economic drivers, contemporaneous guidance/consensus versus actuals, revisions, promised versus delivered milestones and revealing Q&A. Contrast management narrative with cash conversion, accounting policies, segment notes, commitments and contingencies. An unanswered question is neither confirmation nor failure; a footnote discrepancy is an investigation target, not proof of misconduct. Check seasonality, mix, acquisitions, accounting and disclosure lags before naming a turning point.

## Form And Challenge The Thesis

Fix security, exchange, fiscal year, currency, cutoff, current price and horizon. Frame a provisional hypothesis and the few debates capable of changing value; do not select the final verdict before the causal sandbox. The report may lead with the **result after research**, not pretend that the opening judgment was the starting evidence.

Trace a representative collected transaction from customer need through willingness to pay and revenue recognition to owner cash. Reconstruct segment economics; distinguish demand from financing, accounting or underinvestment effects. Investigate the weakest capture, durability, funding or per-share link with original footnotes/contracts/call passages and relevant customer, supplier or competitor evidence. The [business-quality reference](business-quality.md) supplies deeper financial architecture, moat formation and incumbent-advantage checks.

Write the strongest coherent countercase and its differential prediction, without a theatrical persona or fixed word count. If it better explains the evidence, change the conclusion to impairment, unattractive, no demonstrated edge or unresolved. A weak long case is not automatically a short: borrow, financing, timing, loss asymmetry and an independent short payoff still matter.

A claimed variant compares an observed dated expectation or explicit price-implied condition with an independently supported view. Do not invent consensus. Identify the evidenced mispricing mechanism—forced ownership change, accounting lag, category contamination, horizon mismatch—when relevant. Price decline, public good news, national competitiveness or low coverage alone proves none of these.

After an earnings miss or selloff, separate changes in the customer/economic engine, reporting timing/magnitude, and price/holder/liquidity response. Reconcile the event with the earlier supported mechanism before calling it noise. Historical scale and a large decline do not prove the engine intact.

## Value Against The Price

Apply [B's causal sandbox](mode-b-bayesian-growth.md#causal-sandbox-before-scenario-judgment) before final probabilities or verdict. Carry capacity, rival responses, capital, working capital, financing and dilution through coherent future paths, then value each and compare with price requirements. Do not fit the operating forecast to a desired target.

Choose DCF, normalized earnings, SOTP, NAV or multiples by economic fit. Full triangulates when informative; agreement between forward and reverse models sharing assumptions is not independent confirmation. Reconcile per-share rights, diluted shares, net debt/senior claims, distributions and currency. Distinguish present-value gaps from dated holding-period returns.

One price identifies neither a unique forecast nor probability distribution. Keep observed consensus, conditional reverse-valuation solutions and independent underwriting separate. Label sensitive conclusions, disclose missing inputs and retain estimation error. Neither fixed PE bands nor positive FCF, founder ownership or revenue acceleration are universal investment laws. Assess investment-phase losses and cyclical normalization on their economics.

## Delivery And Readiness

Lead the finished report with the completed one-page brief, including the supported answer, return source and live debate. Expand the business mechanism, decisive evidence, strongest countercase and uncertainty without recopying its panels, then close with the entrypoint's scenarios, valuation, signals and six-month catalysts, followed by the supported bet/no-bet recommendation when investment value is in scope. Reconcile the front-page verdict, metrics and forecast labels with that final synthesis after revisions. Full also applies [financial evidence and claim audit](financial-evidence.md); preserve the [writing handoff](../SKILL.md#required-writing-pass-for-final-articles).

Research may rationally end in waiting. Record the business conditions, valuation hurdle and invalidation evidence that would reopen the case; a reached price threshold does not override deteriorating economics. Distinguish strategy exclusion, unattractive price, no demonstrated edge and insufficient understanding. Use `Too Hard at present` only for a decisive link still unbounded after feasible inquiry, with the resolving question and evidence. Do not confuse time spent researching with conviction earned.

# Structured Financial Extraction: U.S., Hong Kong And A-Shares

Use for requested filing extraction or material statement inputs to research. Read the common rules and only the applicable market branch. For a dual-listed issuer, both may be needed to reconcile documents; two listings do not create two sets of consolidated earnings. This module structures evidence, not an investment verdict. Use [financial-evidence.md](financial-evidence.md) for original-source verification and [data-contract.md](data-contract.md) for calculations.

## Direct Parser Entry: No Research Session

`invest` owns extraction and interpretation. When financial tools are already exposed, use their document/statement/table operations directly. Do not start an Alpha research session just to unlock financial tools. If the available MCP only exposes research-session controls, the bundled `scripts/read_financial_statements.py` bypasses that control plane and calls the same Fins parsing/storage backend locally. Do not invoke `alpha-research`, load its frozen method, create a mandate, or submit a report for an extraction task.

The helper requires a Python environment with the existing `alpha.fins` backend and an existing Fins workspace. It is an optional backend, not a copied parser or a standalone replacement for Fins. Use the environment where Fins is installed; do not change `sys.path`, guess a repository path, install packages or initialize a model merely to hide a missing dependency. Backend absence leaves the original SEC/iXBRL and PDF paths available. `--help` itself uses only the standard library.

From a configured project environment, replace `/path/to/invest` with this Skill's actual directory:

```bash
python /path/to/invest/scripts/read_financial_statements.py \
  --workspace ./workspace --output ./workspace/tmp/company-documents.json \
  list --ticker META

python /path/to/invest/scripts/read_financial_statements.py \
  --workspace ./workspace --output ./workspace/tmp/company-statements.json \
  extract --ticker META --document-id ACTUAL_DOCUMENT_ID
```

Choose the actual filing ID from the returned inventory after checking issuer, report type, period and amendment. There is no automatic "latest" selection: the newest 6-K, for example, may not contain the intended financial results. `extract` prepares just that document, reuses matching processing versions and reads income, balance sheet and cash flow by default. `--statement income cash_flow` limits an explicitly narrow request. It uses SEC-native XBRL/HTML or the existing Docling grid parser as supported by that document; it does not download or convert every filing.

If the intended original is not yet stored, use an existing financial downloader/importer. In an already configured Alpha installation the existing command is, for example:

```bash
alpha download --base ./workspace --ticker AAPL --forms 10-Q \
  --start 2026-01-01 --end 2026-11-04
```

The dates are illustrative: choose the user's requested evidence window. Local PDF import likewise needs explicit issuer/report metadata through the existing Fins importer. Do not directly write financial warehouse files. Download/import success is not statement extraction success. No new downloader, identity, credentials or model configuration is introduced by this Skill.

Discover document-local tables before reading notes, reconciliations or missing standard lines:

```bash
python /path/to/invest/scripts/read_financial_statements.py \
  --workspace ./workspace --output ./workspace/tmp/company-tables.json \
  tables --ticker META --document-id ACTUAL_DOCUMENT_ID

python /path/to/invest/scripts/read_financial_statements.py \
  --workspace ./workspace --output ./workspace/tmp/company-note.json \
  table --ticker META --document-id ACTUAL_DOCUMENT_ID --table-ref ACTUAL_TABLE_REF
```

The full JSON export preserves each statement's raw result and receipt: source and processing hashes, source metadata, actual access time, currency/units/scale, original periods/rows and available table/page locators. It does not silently normalize amounts, infer consolidation, subtract cumulative EPS, or replace unknown currency with the trading currency. With `--output`, stdout is a small status/path summary; inspect the saved JSON before using numbers. The export is an evidence artifact, not an Alpha research database entry or formal coverage receipt.

Exit `0` means the requested operation completed; statement status `extracted` means only that finite numeric values, dated columns, currency and units passed basic checks. Exit `2` means partial/unavailable coverage: all returned statement receipts remain available, with per-statement issues. Missing currency, generic `NUMBER` units, empty values, period/value mismatches and unsupported statements remain gaps. Exit `1` means execution/dependency failure. A table status `table_read` is an original table read, not proof of standard three-statement completeness.

After extraction, apply the common and market-specific rules below: verify consolidated scope, actual duration, scaling, signs, ownership and key footnotes against the original. Hashes prove content identity, not economic correctness or first-publication time. Reuse unchanged valid evidence with its original date/version; new filings, amendments or changed processor versions need fresh preparation/verification. If a parser field is missing, inspect the original and label any manual correction with its source; do not rewrite the raw receipt as a successful automated extraction. Image-only pages still require the [PDF/OCR fallback](pdf-retrieval.md).

## Three Layers, One Evidence Chain

Keep these distinguishable in a compact table, JSON or the existing model, according to the requested output:

- **Original evidence:** issuer identity; original document ID/URL, type, language, publication time/precision, revision, audit/review status; row label or concept, table, column headers, printed/PDF page, unit/scale, sign and material notes. Retain raw text/value before normalization. Do not call unaudited results audited because an auditor agreed figures to an underlying statement.
- **Normalized facts and calculations:** metric ID, actual period dates, instant versus duration, fiscal-year label and reporting cadence; currency/scale, accounting standard and adjustments; consolidated/segment scope, continuing operations, ownership attribution and security basis. Keep reported and derived values distinguishable, with formulas and source metric IDs for derivations. Missing is not zero; a dash requires its table convention to be understood.
- **Research interpretation:** what the change may mean, plausible rival explanations and missing evidence. Do not insert interpretation into a reported field or label an analyst estimate as management guidance.

Do not extract every line by default. Cover the requested statements/periods and load-bearing operating detail; report what is missing, incomparable, derived or only partially read. Extraction completeness and economic correctness are separate judgments.

## Common Comparability And Derivation Rules

**Document/version identity.** Build a small inventory of the relevant earnings announcement, full report, presentation, call and amendment. Link complementary documents by economic period. Repeated comparative columns, translations and duplicate exchange/IR copies are not new observations. Keep original and restated versions separately, identify what changed and use a consistent basis for comparisons. A latest amended number must not replace a historical input before that amendment was available. Different filing IDs need not mean different accounting bases; a shared version basis must be established from the disclosures, not invented to pass validation.

**Periods.** Use fiscal start/end dates, not upload date, calendar-quarter guesses or labels alone. Preserve both single-quarter and year-to-date columns where present. For additive flows on a reconciled basis, Q3 = nine months minus six months; Q4 = full year minus nine months; H2 = full year minus H1. Keep inputs and formula and label the result derived. Do not manufacture Q1/Q2 from H1, or Q3/Q4 from H2. Balance-sheet amounts are instants. EPS, margins, customer counts, retention rates and weighted-average shares cannot be mechanically differenced like cash flow. Compute ratios from comparable underlying amounts when supported; differences in cumulative diluted EPS are not reliable standalone quarterly EPS. Preserve 52/53-week and unequal-duration comparisons explicitly.

**Currency and ownership.** Report currency is not trading currency. Distinguish consolidated net income, profit attributable to owners/common shareholders and non-controlling interests. Retain basic versus diluted EPS, weighted-average versus period-end shares, and ordinary shares versus ADS. For an explicitly verified ratio of one ADS to N ordinary shares, EPS per ADS = N × ordinary-share EPS on the same basis; equivalent underlying ordinary shares = N × ADS count. Do not add equivalent dual-listed shares twice. Verify the ratio's effective date and splits; leave a missing ratio unresolved. Currency conversion needs a dated rate, direction and appropriate balance/flow context, not a silent spot conversion of historical statements.

**Adjustments.** Keep US GAAP, IFRS/HKFRS or another disclosed standard explicit; listing venue alone does not establish the standard. Preserve statutory and non-GAAP/non-IFRS values separately and extract the issuer's reconciliation when material. FCF and adjusted earnings definitions differ: show capex, capitalized software, leases, tax and SBC treatment rather than mapping identical labels to identical economics. Do not force banks/insurers into an industrial cash-flow template.

**Checks proportional to the output.** Reconcile assets with liabilities and equity; opening/closing cash with operating, investing, financing, FX and other disclosed movements; consolidated totals with segments plus eliminations/unallocated items; and adjusted figures with their reconciliation. Respect signs, rounding, restricted-cash definitions and changing segment scope. The existing sum checks can test prepared, same-basis identities; they do not discover missing components. Use v2 `period_differences` for explicit cumulative-flow derivations. Other mappings, ADS ratios and version selection still need source inspection; a script pass is not that inspection.

## U.S. Branch

Resolve issuer identity/CIK and filing history first. For relevant domestic issuers, distinguish 10-K/10-Q statements from earnings-release exhibits to 8-K and amendments. For foreign private issuers, inspect the applicable 20-F/40-F annual disclosure and 6-K attachments; not every 6-K is an earnings report, and U.S. listing does not imply quarterly 10-Q reporting or US GAAP.

When available, use SEC structured data/iXBRL to locate facts, then verify the material table and notes. Retain accession, taxonomy/concept, unit, duration/instant and dimensions from the actual filing context. Standard-concept aggregate APIs are not complete segment/KPI or custom-tag extraction. Do not select the last returned value blindly: repeated filings may contain the same period, amended comparatives or different durations. SEC calendar frames are not a substitute for an issuer-specific fiscal series. Use filing HTML/iXBRL tables and IR originals where aggregate data omits the required scope; never invent a missing custom tag.

For calls, use [earnings-transcripts.md](earnings-transcripts.md) to link prepared remarks and complete question/answer exchanges to their actual earnings period.

## Hong Kong Branch

Resolve issuer, stock code, board and reporting cadence from HKEXnews and issuer IR. Match annual/interim results announcements to the subsequent full reports. Use the actual disclosures rather than imposing quarterly financial statements: quarterly operating updates may contain only revenue or sales KPIs, not a full income statement or cash flow. Annual less interim can support a derived second half on a consistent basis, not two invented quarters.

Keep Chinese/English versions linked as versions of one disclosure. Extract original row names as well as normalized names; language or OCR differences should not create new metrics. Verify units such as 元/千元/百万元/亿元 and whether parentheses denote negatives. For image-only tables, use the [PDF fallback](pdf-retrieval.md), inspect headers and relevant footnotes visually, and preserve uncertainty for unreadable cells instead of filling them from neighboring rows.

Retain disclosed accounting standard, reporting currency, profit attribution, share classes and material related-party/associate/joint-venture scope. Revenue from associates is not automatically consolidated revenue. Segment reorganizations need the issuer's restated comparison or an explicit break in series. Profit alerts, trading updates and management outlook are not replacements for subsequently reported statements.

## A-Share Branch

Resolve legal issuer, stock code and exchange (Shanghai, Shenzhen or Beijing); distinguish similarly named entities and A/H share classes. Retrieve original exchange disclosures, CNINFO or issuer-published documents rather than relying on a finance portal's normalized table. Associate the full annual/interim/quarterly report with its summary, correction and relevant attachments. Preserve the actual disclosure date and audit status. Verify current filing requirements separately if asked about compliance; this is not a deadline checklist.

Keep `业绩预告` (forecast range), `业绩快报` (preliminary result), formal reported results and subsequent corrections as separate dated evidence states. A preliminary historical result is not automatically a forecast, but its document type/status must remain visible; a forecast midpoint is a derived assumption, not a reported fact. Reconcile later changes without overwriting what was available earlier. Do not infer withdrawal of a forecast from its omission in a later document.

Read the actual column headers: `本报告期`, `年初至报告期末`, `上年同期`, and `期末` may describe different windows within the same quarterly report. Derive Q2 from H1 minus Q1, Q3 from nine months minus H1, and Q4 from year minus nine months only for comparable additive flows with cited inputs. Preserve single-quarter disclosures separately from calculated values. Apply the common prohibition on mechanically subtracting cumulative EPS, ratios or balance-sheet stocks.

Separate **合并** from **母公司** statements throughout the income, balance-sheet and cash-flow series. Separate consolidated net profit, profit attributable to parent owners (`归母净利润`) and the issuer's disclosed `扣非归母净利润`. Retain the non-recurring-items reconciliation, tax and minority-interest effects where material; deducting a pretax item from after-tax attributable profit is not a valid reconciliation. Recurring cash generation is a research judgment, not a synonym for `扣非`. Keep reported accounting standard and adjustments rather than treating A/H reports as automatically interchangeable.

For material cash-quality questions, inspect the notes connecting `货币资金` to cash equivalents and restricted deposits; receivables, notes receivable, receivables financing, factoring/derecognition and recourse; contract assets/liabilities, inventory and impairments; development expenditure and capitalized R&D. These are possible distinctions, not allegations or a checklist for every company. Do not call all monetary funds spendable, all receivables financing cash, or reduced receivables proof of customer collection. Cross-check capital expenditure with relevant cash-flow lines and asset notes rather than assuming one line captures all investment.

Keep period-end share capital, weighted-average shares and basic/diluted EPS distinct. Preserve effective dates and restated comparatives for bonus shares, capitalization issues, repurchases, issuance and convertibles; do not apply a current share count retroactively without a justified bridge. Units such as 元、万元、亿元 and negative parentheses must follow the table, not the portal default.

Use the existing contract: encode consolidated/parent scope and profit/adjustment attribution explicitly in `basis` for flat v1 sums/basis checks, and use matching `statement.scope`, `concept` and version fields for v2 period differences. Automated equality checks cannot infer scope from a Chinese row label. One successful parse does not establish complete A-share coverage: source selection, forecast/preliminary/final classification and note interpretation still require original-document checks.

## Operating Information Beyond Three Statements

For decision-relevant segments, customers, backlog/orders, retention, pricing, capex and management guidance, retain: original definition; value/range or exact qualitative qualification; population/scope; actual observation period or forecast horizon; source/speaker; and changes from the prior comparable disclosure. Record a KPI as missing/not disclosed only after the applicable material has been checked; inaccessible is a different state. Preserve guidance conditions, withdrawn/redefined metrics and explanatory notes. Do not turn backlog into guaranteed revenue, bookings into cash, or management's causal explanation into an established fact.

For a financial update, carry comparable extracted facts into the existing four-period comparison and anomaly investigation. For extraction only, stop with the requested data, sources, derivations and limitations; no forced target price or new persistent database.

## Primary References

- [SEC EDGAR APIs](https://www.sec.gov/search-filings/edgar-application-programming-interfaces): aggregate API coverage and calendar-frame limits.
- [SEC Form 6-K](https://www.sec.gov/about/forms/form6-k.pdf): foreign-issuer current information, not a universal quarterly report.
- [HKEX issuer disclosure guidance](https://www.hkex.com.hk/Listing/Explore-By-Role/Listed-Issuers/Equity-Securities?sc_lang=en) and [HKEXnews report search](https://www1.hkexnews.hk/search/predefineddoc.xhtml): identify actual report types and publication records. Verify current requirements when the task concerns filing compliance; do not infer them from this extraction guide.
